name: Browsafe
tagline: Browse privately with a built-in VPN
description:
Browsafe is a web browser for Android with a VPN built right in, so you get a secured, private connection without installing a separate app. It also blocks the ads and pop-ups that make browsing annoying.

Because the VPN is baked into the browser itself, turning on a more private connection is just a tap away instead of a separate setup step.
